description: This file defines the MailMergeController class in PHP, responsible for handling mail merge related actions such as search within the SuiteCRM module. It extends the SugarController class and includes a method for performing search queries across different modules, processing request parameters, and returning JSON responses.

classes.name: MailMergeController
classes.description: Controller class for handling mail merge operations, specifically search functionality within SuiteCRM modules. Extends from SugarController and processes AJAX search requests.
